authoritative_contract.clause: Maintenance, no new entries, position-management handoff, consistent backup, migration preflight and startup reconciliation; refuse unverified schema downgrade; preserve user data and versioned backup manifest.

observed_gap.existing_backup: backup.py:38 inventory and :70 _connect provide finite known database inventory and deadline-bounded protected URI reader; _database_facts validates quick_check/FK/schema hash/user_version. Those facts establish snapshot integrity, not compatibility with another release.

It is not a migration preflight and its fencing may open production journals; unsupported schema must be refused before that work.

minimal_product_change.restore_guard: Invoke same compatibility check on verified snapshot bytes before create_private_directory(target), journal fencing or any migration attempt. Preserve generic archival backup/verify ability for unsupported future schema; a valid backup is not permission to open it with an older owner.
canonical_rules: Existing canonical database requires well-formed schema_migrations ledger and exact known ordered-prefix membership against target packaged SQL filenames; unknown/newer names, gaps, duplicates or malformed ledger fail closed. Empty brand-new database is a separate explicit initialization case; an existing arbitrary populated database with no ledger must not be treated as fresh.

Known prefix means migration candidates are a suffix, not proof migrations will succeed. Report required suffix and require migration on a fresh inhibited restored clone plus integrity/reconciliation checks before use.

Current ledger stores names/time only: no historical SQL checksums. Never report retrospective script-content verification. Changing already-applied script under the same name cannot be detected from this ledger alone. Existing distribution seals target scripts; stricter historical checksum compatibility requires explicit trusted historical schema/package evidence, not rewritten history.
minimal_product_change.shared_check: One finite compatibility checker in storage migration owner, used both by canonical writer before first schema write and by target-native read-only preflight. No alternate migrator. Retain existing actual migration execution and transactions.
minimal_product_change.entrypoint: Proposed additive target R7.exe preflight-product-upgrade --config <source-config> --backup <verified-product-bundle>; exact command name remains implementation choice. Pure read-only check under existing ProcessScopeLock for all PROCESS_ROLES; use private/local single-link path checks and finite deadlines, query_only + mode=ro, target verify_distribution on normal frozen entrypoint. Output target source/distribution identity, source config/product instance, verified bundle hash/identity, per-role compatibility facts and pending canonical suffix; financial_authority NONE. No migration, file creation, owner start or authority transfer.
minimal_product_change.all_database_boundary: Use backup._inventory including settings, with verified bundle logical_name/relative_path hashes. Canonical names alone must not yield whole-profile compatible. For other present application stores, reuse their actual schema/version contracts; if no supported source-to-target contract exists, return typed unsupported/unverified for that role. Do not use user_version=0 or quick_check=ok as compatibility proof. Safe minimum first release can support only exactly validated known noncanonical schemas and refuse changes; expanding other-store migration is separate.
minimal_product_change.no_owner_bypass: Normal canonical open must deny unknown/non-prefix schema even if operator skips advisory CLI. Acquire existing maintenance locks and preserve restore inhibition; no new E5/risk/policy engine, open-position automatic upgrade or installer.

Fresh full ZIP extraction into installation1/installation2, actual doctor/product-status/start/stop using external data, then operator removal of verified synthetic installation1 only can prove portable relocation/removal and preservation; no MSI/registry/Windows uninstall claim.

Current normal commands have no documented migration-preflight or Windows upgrade command. Same-version two-copy test is not cross-version schema evidence. Rollback uses untouched old data or verified old backup in fresh inhibited generation, never old binary against migrated new data.

old7d_evidence.usable_scope: Original qualified ZIP full-byte extraction/empty-PATH native smoke/same-version backup-verify-restore-rebackup only. Preserve originals. Not cross-version compatibility, arbitrary downgrade, new candidate qualification, old PC or Ubuntu proof.

Then old target must actually refuse newer schema with zero writes. Retain both exact executable/distribution identities and bundle/ledger facts; do not transfer old7d qualification or infer financial authority.
